entities.summary: Ulrich Pinner is a former professional tennis player from Germany. He achieved a career-high singles ranking of world No. 19 in August 1979 and was the German No. 1 from 1978-1980. Ulrich Pinner was a athletes & competitors from Zittau (b. 1954-02-07, Zittau). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
